name: sondar-proyect
description: SONDAR: desarrollo web, API y herramientas manuales de base de datos.

scripts.install_all: npm install && npm install --prefix Backend && npm install --prefix Frontend
scripts.omega: npm run install_all && npm run dev
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev:server --prefix Backend" "npm run dev --prefix Frontend -- --host localhost --port 3001 --strictPort"
scripts.dev:all:lan: concurrently "npm run dev:server --prefix Backend" "npm run dev --prefix Frontend -- --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix Backend && npm run test --prefix Frontend
scripts.verify: npm run db:validar && npm run test && npm run lint && npm run build
